description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called DashboardView, which displays user information, a greeting header, and a calculator card within a dashboard screen. It manages user interaction through environment objects and SwiftUI view composition.

classes.description: A SwiftUI View representing the user dashboard, including greeting, user info, and a calculator section.
